name: Final Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the final status of a transaction.

STLD.name: Settled
STLD.definition: Transaction has been successfully processed by the clearing agent.

RJTD.name: Rejected
RJTD.definition: Transaction has been rejected by the clearing agent.

FNLD.name: Finalised
FNLD.definition: Transaction has been successfully processed by the clearing agent. Settlement will take place outside of the system.
